findings.title: An active promotion resting entirely on the confounded instrument
findings.gate: v3_exq_429_inv044_bayesian_prior_before_posterior.py:316 -- outcome = PASS iff (c1_pass and c2_pass); BOTH are the raw whole-bank statistic

C1.defect: Threshold ~20x below the untouched-bank value (0.9993). An empty bank passes with P=1.0000. Measured 0.288 == whole-bank cosine ~0.71, i.e. substantial homogenisation, read by C1 as success.

C2.defect: Compares ORDERED's mid-training per-cycle mean against WAKING's end-of-training final value. Per 436d F5 the baseline is Adam drift on context_memory.memory and is non-monotone in training time.

C4.defect: 0.0 is the agent.py:11197 metrics-dict default, not a measurement -- REM_ONLY runs no SWS pass. Guaranteed to pass whenever ORDERED > 0. Quoted in the promotion note as the leading contrast.

findings.consequence: 100% of INV-044's experimental evidence base is the confounded instrument. There is no unaffected experimental evidence to fall back on. Promotion to provisional (governance 2026-04-19) quoted the confounded numbers verbatim.

findings.criterion: 430 C3 -- SLEEP mean_sws_slot_diversity > 0.02 in ALL seeds; passed 3/3 at 0.342 / 0.290 / 0.083
findings.recorded_note: SWS slots differentiated (C3 3/3) but did not translate to behavioral harm reduction -- symptom of missing MECH-261 mode-conditioned offline-write gating substrate.
findings.defect: Against the 0.9993 untouched-bank value those readings are whole-bank cosine ~0.66 / 0.71 / 0.92 -- the bank became substantially MORE homogeneous. 'Slots differentiated' is inverted. NO_SLEEP reads 0.0, the same agent.py:11197 placeholder.

findings.title: Both supporting runs carry the confound, neither decisively

265a.defect: same vacuity class as F1 C1 (P=1.0000 on an empty bank); not the sole criterion

500a.detail: rem_n_rollouts=6.0, sws_n_writes=8.0 -> non-diversity part is EXACTLY 8.0, so C3 passes under >= with or without the confounded term. But 100% of the visible margin is that term, and a strict > would have made it the sole reason for the pass.
500a.secondary: Reports sws_slot_diversity ~0.9995 with slot_diversity_before_test == slot_diversity_after_test to full float precision in every cycle and seed -- the untouched-bank null despite 8 writes/cycle, because 8 EMA writes (0.9*old + 0.1*new) barely perturb a near-orthogonal init. targets.recommended_epistemic_category_note: The FAILURE MODE is measurement/test-design defect. That string is NOT a valid claims.yaml epistemic_category -- the enum is the eight values in validate_claims.VALID_EPISTEMIC_CATEGORIES -- and governance writes this field through verbatim. `standard` is the behaviour-preserving mapping: it asserts no epistemic suppression, which is the correct verdict here (the claim is untested, not substrate-gated), and it keeps GOV-GRAN-1 surfacing and v3-testability unchanged. targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-429 (2026-04-18 / 2026-04-19) reclassified supports -> non_contributory 2026-08-20: the PASS gate is `c1_pass and c2_pass` and BOTH criteria are the raw whole-bank sws_slot_diversity, which is 1 - slot_cosine_sim over all 16 ContextMemory slots with only the diagonal masked. An untouched 16-slot bank reads 1.0004 +/- 0.0087 (n=200 fresh inits on the live substrate, re-measured 2026-08-20), so C1's `> 0.05` is cleared by an EMPTY bank with P=1.0000 -- it is a homogenisation detector read as a differentiation detector, and the measured ORDERED 0.288 corresponds to whole-bank cosine ~0.71, i.e. substantial homogenisation scored as success. C2 compares ORDERED's mid-training per-cycle mean against WAKING_ONLY's end-of-training final value, two points on a drifting nuisance trajectory. The promotion rationale's leading contrast, 'ORDERED 0.290 vs REM_ONLY 0.0', is a real readout against a PLACEHOLDER: 0.0 is the initialised default in run_sws_schema_pass's metrics dict, returned unchanged when sws_enabled is False, and REM_ONLY runs no SWS pass. This removes 2/2 of INV-044's experimental evidence. The claim is NOT falsified -- it is untested; its 6 literature entries (lit_conf 0.861) are unaffected, and `provisional` is retained on that literature basis alone, stated explicitly (user-confirmed 2026-08-20). Substrate unrepaired as of 2026-08-20.

GOV-APPLY-1 self-clearing trap, caught and fixed during confirmation: the INV-044 per_claim_recommendation.change string first written at this confirmation ended '... reading stays -> provisional'. _reflects() parses the text after the LAST '->' and matches it against evidence_direction / epistemic_category / status / live_status.reading -- and INV-044 already stores status 'provisional' AND live_status.reading 'provisional', so the audit cleared a disposition that is entirely unapplied. Verified live: INV-044 was ABSENT from the ACTIONABLE list.
